sections.Profile:
Middle Earth , released by Atari in February 1978, is a four-player solid-state widebody designed by Gary Slater, with fantasy-themed artwork by George Opperman. Its split playfield has two pairs of offset flippers, one pair for the upper field and one for the lower, along with two banks of five drop targets, and the score displays sit on the apron rather than in the backbox.

- Years made: 1978
